_comment: Арт КодКвеста. Промпт = prompt айтема + look группы + style + avoid. Блоки style/avoid не менять посреди набора — на них держится единый стиль. Цвета — из app/static/css/app.css.
style: STYLE: cute chunky 2D game mascot illustration for a kids coding school, bold rounded shapes, thick dark violet outline #1d1838, flat colors with soft cel shading, light from top-left, big friendly expressive eyes, confident cheerful mood, centered single subject, generous empty margin around the subject, clean silhouette readable at 64 px, flat solid magenta #FF00FF background, uniform color, no gradient, no texture, no shadow on the background, no cast shadow, subject floating on flat background
avoid: NEGATIVE: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no frame, no border, no multiple subjects, no collage, no sprite sheet, no photorealism, no 3D render, no pink or magenta colors on the subject, no logos or characters from existing games or brands

skin_themes._comment: Скины бойцов — запас виртуальных наград (tools/gpu-queue.md, п. 6). Промпт скина = prompt бойца + тема + look brawler + style + avoid. Лицо, силуэт и основной цвет бойца сохраняются — меняется только наряд.
skin_themes.winter: same character, now wearing a cosy knitted winter scarf and a small woolly hat with a pompom, a few snowflakes around
skin_themes.cyber: same character, now with glowing cyan visor goggles and a sleek futuristic armor trim in dark violet with cyan light lines
skin_themes.space: same character, now in a chunky white astronaut suit with a round clear helmet, small mission patch without text

looks.brawler: bust portrait from the chest up, body turned slightly to the right, looking at the viewer
looks.world: single emblem object, front view, like a round game level badge icon
